# MM-P3-L4-SB03 — Maintenance manual - Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-SB03

Scope
- This document defines routine maintenance tasks required to sustain safe and reliable operation of Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3. It applies to preventive maintenance related to wear items, media handling, and mechanical fasteners on EQ-P3-L4-SB03. Refer to related documents SB-1019, SB-1038, SOP-P3-L4-02 for complementary procedures and safety requirements.

Tools
- Torque wrench capable of achieving the specified bolt torque for wheel liner replacement.  
- Socket set sized for the wheel liner fasteners.  
- Clean containers for recovered media and debris.  
- Personal protective equipment as required by SOP-P3-L4-02.

Procedure
- Isolate and lock out power and air following SOP-P3-L4-02 before any access to internal components of EQ-P3-L4-SB03.  
- Remove access panels to expose the blast wheel assembly and liners. Inspect liners for localized wear, fractures, and securement.  
- When replacing or re-securing the blast wheel liner, tighten liner bolts to the blast wheel liner bolt torque for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) is 90 N·m. Confirm each bolt is torqued to that value using a calibrated torque wrench.  
- Inspect media handling path and reclaim system for blockages. Top up shot media as needed to maintain effective blasting. The shot media top-up interval for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) is 48 hours; record each top-up in the maintenance log referenced in SB-1019.  
- Reinstall access panels, remove lockout, and execute a functional test run in accordance with SOP-P3-L4-02.

Acceptance criteria
- Blast wheel liner is securely installed with all liner bolts torqued to the blast wheel liner bolt torque for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) is 90 N·m.  
- Media level maintained per the shot media top-up interval for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) is 48 hours and documented.  
- No abnormal vibration, noise, or material bypass observed during the functional test.  
- Maintenance actions and references to SB-1019, SB-1038, SOP-P3-L4-02 recorded in the equipment maintenance log.
